attributes.board_name: Junta Examinadora de Psicólogos de Puerto Rico (Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education activities approved or validated (convalidadas) by the Junta; no limit on modules, journals or internet per renewal requirements sheet
rules.new_licensee_rule: Full 45 hours required from the first triennium (Resolución 2018-182; Reglamento 9737 Sec. 11.2).
rules.carryover: No carryover of hours from one triennium to the next.
rules.notes: Recertification every 3 years from first registration. Ethics: 2 courses x 3 h (part 1 in person/synchronous). 3 h technology/telepsychology for recertifications from Mar 1, 2027. 2 h equity/non-discrimination from 2025 triennium. 15 h autism (TEA) for those serving people with ASD.
rules.legal_basis: Ley 96-1983; Reglamento 9737 (Registro y Educación Continua), Art. 10-11; Resoluciones 2018-182, 2019-532, 2024-86, 2024-87
